jobs.title: AI First iOS Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At OPENLANE we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful.

We’re a technology company
building the world’s most advanced—and uncomplicated—digital marketplace for used vehicles.
We’re a data company
helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use.
And we’re an innovation company
accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit.

Our Values:

Driven Waybuilders
. We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create, and innovate.
Relentless Curiosity.
We seek to understand and improve our customers’ experience.
Smart Risk-Taking.
We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition.
Fearless Ownership.
We deliver what we promise and learn along the way.

We’re Looking For:
We’re hiring AI-first Software Engineers (iOS) to build, evolve, and scale OPENLANE’s digital marketplace mobile experiences.
These roles are for engineers who already treat AI as a first-class development tool, not a novelty. You’ll use AI to move faster, ship higher-quality software, and reduce operational and development toil, while still applying strong engineering judgment, ownership, and systems thinking.
You’ll work on customer-facing wholesale marketplace apps, partnering closely with Product, Senior iOS engineers, Android, and backend teams.

AI is an accelerator. Engineering ownership still matters.

Why OPENLANE:
Work on real-time, high-value marketplace systems at scale
Be part of a major platform modernization and AI transformation
Use AI as a first-class development tool—not an experiment
Collaborate with experienced engineers, product leaders, and platform teams
Grow in an environment that values learning, ownership, and impact

You Are:
AI-forward.
You already use AI tools to enhance development speed, quality, and efficiency, and you continuously adapt as tooling evolves.
Product-minded.
You think beyond code and understand how technical decisions impact customers and business outcomes.
Ownership-driven.
You take responsibility for systems end-to-end, including reliability and operational health.
Technically curious.
You enjoy learning new technologies and thoughtfully evaluating emerging approaches.
Quality-focused.
You value clean, maintainable code, strong testing practices, and production-ready engineering standards.

You Bring:
Core Engineering Skills

Experience shipping production iOS features in a team codebase
Solid Swift and SwiftUI skills; willingness to navigate UIKit where it still exists
Comfort with CI, tests, and code review
Growing end-to-end ownership of features with guidance from Senior engineers

AI-First Mindset

Actively uses AI development tools (code copilots, AI debuggers, test generators)
Curious about applying AI to real customer and business problems
Able to critically evaluate AI outputs instead of blindly accepting them
Comfortable learning and adapting in a fast-changing tool landscape

Technical Experience

Swift; SwiftUI views and ViewModels
Basic networking and app architecture (MVVM or similar)
Familiarity with feature flags and mobile analytics
Unit and/or UI testing
Willingness to grow snapshot testing

You Will:
Implement iOS features primarily in modern SwiftUI across seller and buyer marketplace experiences
Ship flag-gated work; write unit/UI tests; meet dual-OS PR gate expectations with support
Use AI tools daily to accelerate coding, tests, and debugging—then verify before merge
Collaborate with Product/design; learn shared platform concerns under Senior guidance
Pair with Android counterparts on shared product behavior

How You’ll Use AI in This Role:
AI-assisted coding and refactoring
AI-generated test coverage and validation
AI-supported debugging and root-cause analysis
AI-assisted documentation and knowledge sharing
Applying AI tools to reduce repetitive work and increase engineering leverage

Who You Will Work With:
Reporting to an Engineering Manager (Mobile), this role collaborates closely with Product Managers, designers, backend and platform engineers, QA, Senior iOS engineers, and the sibling Android mobile team on a daily basis.

Must Have’s:
3+ years professional iOS development (or equivalent depth)
Proficiency in Swift
Experience building apps with SwiftUI
Experience shipping at least one App Store app
AI-first mindset and active use of AI development tools with critical evaluation of outputs
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have’s:
Snapshot testing experience
Exposure to SPM modules and shared UI component libraries
Marketplace / e-commerce mobile experience
Interest in growing into auth, flags, and analytics ownership over time
Familiarity with hybrid WebView surfaces

What We Offer:

Competitive pay

Medical, dental, and vision benefits with employer HSA contributions (US) and FSA options (US)

Immediately vested 401K (US) or RRSP (Canada) with company match

Paid Vacation, Personal, and Sick Time

Paid maternity and paternity leave (US)

Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance, and AD&D (US)

Robust Employee Assistance Program

Employer paid Leap into Service Day to volunteer

Tuition Reimbursement for eligible programs

Opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge across a publicly traded, global organization

Company culture of internal promotions, diverse career paths, and meaningful advancement

Sound like a match? Apply Now - We can't wait to hear from you!

Compensation Range of

Annual Salary: $85,000.00 - $125,000.00 USD (Depending on experience, skill set, qualifications, and other relevant factors.)

Show more

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Internet Marketplace Platforms

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Domino’s is a purpose-inspired, performance-driven company powered by exceptional people who are committed to feeding the power of possible—one pizza at a time. Founded in 1960 as a single store in Ypsilanti, Michigan, Domino’s has grown into the largest pizza company in the world, with more than 22,300 stores across 90+ markets. Our success is built on the strength of our people, technology, and franchise system. As a leader in innovation, we continue to transform the pizza and QSR industry while creating opportunities for team members to learn, grow and thrive. If you're ready to make an impact, build a meaningful career and help shape what's next, there's a place for you at Domino's.

Job Description

Domino’s continues its journey towards the dominant #1 Pizza Company in the world and sound data is the most fundamental of assets that helps us drive towards that. To help accelerate our drive, we are looking for a driven Databricks Data Platform Engineer to join our team at World Resource Center (WRC) in Ann Arbor, MI.

Main Responsibilities

Administer and support Databricks workspaces, clusters, jobs, runtimes, compute policies, SQL Warehouses, and platform configurations.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues involving cluster instability, failed/slow jobs, performance bottlenecks, connectivity issues, resource constraints, and platform availability.
Manage Databricks governance and security, including Entra ID/AAD groups, service principals, permissions, secrets, Unity Catalog, and workspace access.
Perform performance and cost optimization, including cluster sizing, autoscaling, Photon, workload optimization, compute policies, and cloud cost reduction.
Develop and maintain CI/CD, automation, job orchestration, and Infrastructure-as Code solutions using tools such as Azure DevOps and Terraform.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, DataOps, Infrastructure, Security, DBA, and vendor teams to resolve production issues and support platform operations.
Participate in incident management, change/release processes, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement activities.
Create and maintain operational runbooks, support documentation, and standard operating procedures.
Take ownership of production issues and independently drive them through troubleshooting, resolution, and follow-up actions.
Good to have SQL Server and MongoDB administration/support experience, with the ability to troubleshoot platform issues as needed and collaborate effectively with required teams.

Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks administration and L2/L3 production support.
Strong hands-on cloud experience, preferably Azure, including networking, storage, identity/access, security, monitoring, and Databricks integration.
Proven experience troubleshooting complex production issues involving Databricks performance, connectivity, availability, jobs, and resource constraints.
Strong communication, ownership, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently drive issues to resolution.
Good to have: Hands-on experience with SQL Server and MongoDB administration.
Work Location: Ability to work onsite 4 days per week at the main office in Ann Arbor, MI.

Additional Information

Benefits:

Paid Holidays and Vacation  
Medical, Dental & Vision benefits that start on the first day of employment
No-cost mental health support for employee and dependents
Childcare tuition discounts
No-cost fitness, nutrition, and wellness programs
Fertility benefits
Adoption assistance
401k matching contributions  
15% off the purchase price of stock  
Company bonus  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: React/Node.js Developer
jobs.description:
React/Node.js Developer - Remote - Full-time Opportunity -Candidates should possess US Citizenship, reside in US and be willing to go through the federal background check due to the nature of the client.

Position Summary:

Global Alliant is seeking an experienced **React/Node.js Developer** to support key modernization and digital transformation initiatives at a Federal Healthcare client. The ideal candidate is a skilled full-stack developer with strong expertise in **React.js**, **Node.js**, and cloud-based application development, with a working understanding of **federal health IT standards** and security compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

- Design and develop responsive front-end applications using **React.js**, integrated with RESTful services.
- Develop scalable and secure backend APIs using **Node.js** and Express.
- Work closely with UI/UX designers, architects, and CMS stakeholders to build intuitive and accessible user interfaces.
- Implement modern development practices, including **DevSecOps**, **automated testing**, **containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)**, and **CI/CD pipelines**.
- Ensure applications meet **508 compliance**, **FISMA** security standards, and align with **CMS QPP/CMS E&E** architecture frameworks (if applicable).
- Integrate applications with **CMS-specific APIs**, cloud services (AWS/Azure), and legacy systems as needed.
- Participate in Agile ceremonies (Scrum, Sprint Planning, Retrospective) and contribute to backlog grooming and solutioning.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

- **5+ years** of experience in front-end and back-end development with **React.js and Node.js**.
- Strong understanding of **JavaScript/TypeScript**, **ES6+**, **HTML5**, and **CSS3/SASS**.
- Proficiency with **RESTful API design**, **MongoDB/PostgreSQL**, and **JSON-based services**.
- Experience working on **federal or healthcare-related** IT projects (CMS experience preferred).
- Familiarity with **AWS or Azure**, especially serverless architecture and cloud security practices.
- Working knowledge of **Agile development**, **JIRA**, **Git**, and **DevOps tooling** (GitLab, Jenkins, etc.).
- Understanding of **Section 508 compliance**, **OAuth2**, and **JWT authentication** flows.

Preferred Experience:

- Prior experience working directly with Federal Healthcare agencies.
- Familiarity with **FHIR**, **CQL/Clinical Quality Language**.
- Knowledge of **Terraform**, **Ansible**, or other Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools.
- Experience with **automated testing frameworks** (Jest, Cypress, Mocha/Chai).

Education & Clearance:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience).
- Ability to obtain and maintain a **Public Trust clearance**.

Why Join Global Alliant?

- Be part of an award-winning team recognized for innovation and excellence in federal IT.
- Competitive compensation, health benefits, and opportunities for growth within a **CMMI Level 3** and **ISO-certified** environment.

Mid-Senior level
